# memory-for-ai

> An open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that indexes a codebase into a persistent knowledge graph of functions, classes, call chains, HTTP routes, and cross-service links. AI coding agents query the graph instead of reading files one by one, answering structural questions with roughly 120x fewer tokens (~3,400 vs ~412,000 across five structural queries). Parses 162 languages via vendored tree-sitter grammars, with Hybrid LSP semantic type resolution for Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, C#, Go, C/C++, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Perl. Semantic vector search runs on bundled nomic-embed-code embeddings compiled into the native executable — no API key, no Ollama, no Docker. Ships a native self-contained executable (macOS / Linux / Windows) with a built-in graph UI. All processing is local — there is no embedded LLM and no telemetry; the MCP client is the intelligence layer.

## Key facts

- License: MIT, open source.
- Languages: 162 (162 vendored tree-sitter grammars compiled into the binary; count generated into product-metadata.json by scripts/check-product-metadata.py).
- Hybrid LSP type resolution: 11 language families — Python, TypeScript/JavaScript/JSX/TSX, PHP, C#, Go, C/C++, Java, Kotlin, Rust, Perl — a lightweight C implementation of language type-resolution algorithms, structurally inspired by and compatible with tsserver/typescript-go, pyright, gopls, Roslyn, Eclipse JDT, and rust-analyzer.
- MCP tools: 18 (index_repository, search_graph incl. semantic_query vector search, query_graph (read-only Cypher subset), trace_path, get_code_snippet, get_graph_schema, compare_graphs, get_architecture, search_code, get_code_actions, list_projects, delete_project, index_status, check_index_coverage, detect_changes, manage_adr, ingest_traces, get_runtime_traces).
- Coverage honesty: index_repository / index_status / check_index_coverage report skipped files, parse_partial line ranges, a file-hash coverage_ratio, and machine-readable confidence_reasons; absence of a flag is never a completeness guarantee.
- Per-project isolation: `install --project` writes a repo-local `.mcp.json` server entry named memory-for-ai-<repo> pinned with `--scope=<repo>` — one fenced graph per repository, zero global config changes; one binary still serves all repositories.
- Team sharing: `index_repository(persistence=true)` writes a compressed `.memory-for-ai/graph.db.zst` artifact teammates bootstrap from instead of re-indexing.
- Cross-service linking: HTTP route ↔ call-site matching, gRPC/GraphQL/tRPC detection, pub/sub channels (EMITS/LISTENS_ON), and CROSS_* edges across multiple indexed repos.
- Supported agents: 45 automatic/conditional client surfaces (39 automatically detected + 6 conditional/explicit): Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Zed, OpenCode, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Kiro, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Junie, Factory Droid, Grok Build, Amp, Devin, and 28 more — full list in the installation reference. Each receives documented MCP entries plus skills/instructions/tiered graph agents (Scout/Verify/Auditor) where the client has a safe contract. Preview exact writes with `memory-for-ai install --dry-run`.
- Performance: Linux kernel (28M LOC, 75K files) full index in 3 minutes → 4.81M nodes, 7.72M edges; Cypher queries in under 1ms.
- Evaluation: arXiv:2603.27277 — across 31 real repositories, 83% answer quality, 10x fewer tokens, 2.1x fewer tool calls vs. file-by-file exploration.
- Distribution: native executable plus authenticated release-owned assets; fully static Linux builds in the `-portable` archives. Also available through npm, PyPI, Homebrew, Scoop, Winget, Chocolatey, AUR, and `go install`.

## Docs

- [Agent operating guide](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md): the complete manual for AI agents — mental model, all 18 tools with exact semantics, task→tool playbooks, correctness protocol (coverage/confidence/staleness), per-project tuning (.cbmignore, extra extensions, index modes), project isolation, CI/containers, failure modes.
- [Installation reference](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): every install path — one-liners, per-project mode, package managers, manual MCP config, CI/containers, update/uninstall, build from source, artifact verification.
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md): config files, config-set runtime keys, environment variables, scoped sessions, daemon rendezvous.
- [Measuring real effectiveness](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/MEASURING.md): 15-minute spot check, built-in measurement surfaces, rigorous A/B protocol with formulas and reporting schema.
